sites.rationale: Ledger line 1 (PMC12959882) explicitly states 'position 557 (on eAE1)', anchoring this to eAE1 canonical numbering. Ledger line 2 (PMC9623938) independently places a Myc tag at the same position in the third extracellular loop of kAE1, corroborating the site. Python computation confirms residue 557 = V within extracellular loop 542–569; 'at position 557' is interpreted as insert_after_residue = 556 (tag placed before V557), giving residue_before = N (556) and residue_after = V (557). Both flanking positions are well within the extracellular loop, ≥13 aa from either TM boundary, with no cysteines or glycosylation sequons in the loop. Two independent papers report epitope-tag insertions at eAE1 position 557 in full-length, membrane-anchored kAE1/eAE1 constructs expressed in mammalian cells. PMC12959882 uses an HA tag in a lentiviral kAE1 construct for cell-based studies; PMC9623938 uses a Myc tag at the same position in pcDNA3.1-kAE1 constructs to study wild-type and T444N mutant trafficking. Both papers explicitly state 'position 557 (on eAE1)' or 'position 557 in the third extracellular loop of kAE1', confirming eAE1 canonical numbering. Python confirms residue 557 = V (Val) within extracellular loop 542–569, 15 aa from the upstream TM boundary (541) and 13 aa from the downstream TM boundary (570). No cysteines or NxS/T glycosylation motifs are present in loop 542–569. [validation: surface_only; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

The computed extracellular loop 542–569 encompasses the paper's EL3 start (555); the paper's upper boundary (576) extends into the TM per authoritative topology, but the insertion is within the extracellular portion. This site is in the same loop as Site 1 but grounded in a separate ledger line with independent surface-expression validation, so it is reported separately per instructions. The paper's EL3 boundaries (555–576) overlap with the computed extracellular loop 542–569; residues 570–576 fall in the TM per the authoritative topology, so the tag insertion is within the extracellular portion of EL3 (542–569). literature_notes: Four ledger lines were evaluated. Lines 1 (PMC12959882) and 2 (PMC9623938) both pin an epitope tag to eAE1 position 557 in EL3 and are consolidated as Site 1 (the stronger, residue-resolved site). Lines 3 and 4 (PMC11769940) report a V5 tag inserted into EL3 of eAE1 without naming a junction residue, yielding Site 2 (region-level). The C-terminal HA tag on kAE1 reported in PMC9623938 was disqualified because the C-terminus of eAE1/kAE1 is intracellular (topology 870–911). No ledger line supports any other extracellular loop or terminus of SLC4A1. The N-terminus (residues 1–404) is entirely intracellular and carries no qualifying insertion. The kAE1 isoform offset of 65 residues was verified computationally: kAE1 EL3 (490–511) maps to eAE1 EL3 (555–576), consistent with both papers.
